notes.title: Version 1.0.1 bugs fix & optimization update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197195/852545c8420e90b678213c4be8831954e2a93bf8.png"][/img]Thanks for your awesome feedback to help bringing the game to the perfect shape, all reported bugs have been fixed in addition some game optimizations:[/p][list][*][p]We optimized the game in hope that fixed the random crashing at the end of each night won't happen anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in Night 1 Motel where you can get stuck in Room 1 after you give the key to Garry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in Night 2 motel where the roaming car won't spawn after giving the key to Ms. Smith.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing colliders on some game objects in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in Night 4 after work where you can bring the elevator down after the cop goes up with you.[/p][/*][*][p]various minor fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you faced any further bugs or any problem don't hesitate to report that to the following e-mail:
binarylunar@gmail.com[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Hot fix 1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] English has been set as default language instead of Arabic.
[*] fixed all language issues related to Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Russian which caused of appearing squares instead of letters.
[/list]

notes.title: The Nightmare has been released!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197195/e09c24e92d9a270552b1e7b4f8d8c6caea667abd.png"][/img][/p][p]After more than one year of hard work we are proud to release our game, we hope you enjoy it and we are waiting for feedback![/p]

notes.title: No more AI voices, we got a new cast with real actors now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197195/ca52a06ba5e2af7f0c108a92b22d3760df70c7cb.png[/img]
We heard you well, we have changed the voices in the game! so now enjoy listening to real actors with powerful emotions!
Try the new demo update to listen the new voices!
Thanks for the new cast team:

Casting Director - Steve Lloyd

Voice Actors
Emma - MJ Guenther
Anderson - Steve Lloyd
Garry - Jeremy Tucker
Lucas - Jon DeBenedict
Unknown Caller - Ethan James Smith
